_doc: Reranker configs of eval-matrix mode=dump|rerank (research/reranker-eval.md). models: GGUFs the seed job adds to the models cache, pinned by HF revision and sha256. configs: name -> window, from_dump (the dump's own pointwise scores, no model) and research env; IR_LISTWISE_MODEL names a file of models. dump: the configs a dump run ranks.
